what: SHA-256 of the six reference files written by loomora_refgen (basic, empty, escape40, multi, multi-light, one). Reference = the six hashes of the golden constants of core/tests/format_selftest.cpp, held once in the files stored under validation/evidence/adr-0021/windows-11-x64/. Files byte-identical to the reference are not stored again (ADR 0014); only their hash is recorded here.
platform_note: The i686 build (cmake/toolchains/linux-gcc-i686.cmake, g++ 15.2.0 -m32) ran as a 32-bit process on the 64-bit kernel of the WSL2 distribution Ubuntu-26.04, not in the Ubuntu 24.04 distribution that validation/platforms/linux-i686.json describes; same installation, same 64-bit kernel, not a native 32-bit system.

runs.target: linux-i686-gcc, with the SSE2 switch (final state)
runs.toolchain: cmake/toolchains/linux-gcc-i686.cmake with LOOMORA_TEST_FP_FLAGS = -msse2 -mfpmath=sse (applied to the test programs only by loomora_test_fp(); libloomora stays on x87)
runs.ran: loomora_refgen and loomora_format_selftest (ctest 3 of 3, Catch2 loomora_tests included)
runs.note: Not stored: byte-identical to the files of windows-11-x64/. Fallback taken: x87-double-fixtures (validation/fallbacks.json).

runs.target: linux-i686-gcc, WITHOUT the SSE2 switch (the proof that the fallback is needed)
runs.toolchain: same toolchain, test fixtures on the x87 unit; the two files come from the directory xtarget-refs/fp-fstore of the run, named for the -ffloat-store attempt (cross_arch_results.json: -ffloat-store alone was not enough), and their hashes are those recorded for the first run without a switch
runs.ran: loomora_refgen; on the first run without any switch loomora_format_selftest FAILED (multi and multi-light differ) and loomora_tests had 2 failures (write_double(0.1 + 0.2) gives 0.3; nails of layout 2)
runs.note: The two stored files are the x87 output kept in fp-fstore; their SHA-256 equal those recorded for the first run without a switch in cross_arch_results.json (multi b1f56507..., multi-light 10f8dfc2...). Both files still pass python tools/check_loomora.py (valid files with different nail coordinates). The same fixtures on SSE2 give the reference bytes.
